<thought>Search the template catalog with a larger limit to find a template that specifically represents the Wolff‑Kishner reduction (ketone → alkane). Using the functional group “ketones” broken and increasing the result limit should return more candidates, including one that contains the N‑N (hydrazine) pattern typical for Wolff‑Kishner.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 20
}</action_input>
